extracted.intended_audience: California rental housing providers, property managers, and CAA members
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and product features for choosing and accessing California rental housing forms (printable, online fill-in, or integrated) that ensure compliance with California law and integrate with property management workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure full compliance with California law
rubrics_metrics.description: CAA’s forms are expertly developed by CAA’s compliance and legal team to ensure full compliance with California law.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use CAA-provided forms to reduce legal risk; refer to CAA industry insights (e.g., foreign language rules) for specific legal requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form format options — printable vs online vs integrated
rubrics_metrics.description: To fit the needs of every rental housing provider, CAA delivers forms in three flexible formats: printable forms, online fill-in forms, or integrated forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose printable forms for simple, no-frills access; online fill-in for browser-based completion; integrated forms for importing into property management solutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Printable Forms — simple no‑frills access
rubrics_metrics.description: Printable forms offer CAA members simple, no-frills access to the documents you need, anytime.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Best for members who prefer paper copies or basic digital downloads without software integration or online fill-in features.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online Fill-in Forms — browser-based completion and generation
rubrics_metrics.description: Online fill-in forms upgrade lets you complete and generate accurate documents quickly, right from your browser.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Good for speed and reduced data entry errors; supports creating packages and sending lease agreements by email with electronic signature workflows (DocuSign).

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrated Forms — import-ready templates for PMS
rubrics_metrics.description: CAA’s integrated forms upgrade is for members with 200 or more units and is designed for smooth import into major property management systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targeted at larger portfolios (200+ units) that require bulk import into platforms like Yardi or AppFolio; contact CAA to obtain files ready for upload.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility requirement for integrated forms (200+ units)
rubrics_metrics.description: Integrated forms upgrade is for members with 200 or more units.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Members must meet the 200-unit threshold to receive integrated form files; contact CAA at (800) 967-4222 for more information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coverage of common rental documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Popular printable forms include Application to Rent; Move-In Move-Out Itemized Statement; Lease Agreement; Assistive Animal Request and Documentation Packet; Rental Agreement Month-to-Month; Itemized Disposition of Security Deposit; Pet Addendum; Twenty-Four Hour Notice to Enter Dwelling Unit/Premises; Checklist of Disclosures, Forms, Publications, and Postings Mandated for California Rental Housing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CAA provides a broad set of standard documents commonly required for California rental operations; verify specific needs against this list when selecting forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Spanish-language contract negotiation rule
rubrics_metrics.description: California law requires that a contract be provided in Spanish only if it is negotiated in Spanish.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to CAA’s Industry Insight 'Foreign Language Rental Agreements and Leases' for more information on language obligations and best practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online Forms Tool — create branded online library
rubrics_metrics.description: Create your own online forms library with logos and personal branding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use branding features to present forms under your company identity when sending to applicants or tenants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online Forms Tool — auto-populate fields and auto-math
rubrics_metrics.description: Save time by using auto-populate fields and auto-math functions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reduces repetitive data entry and calculation errors across document bundles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online Forms Tool — e-signature and distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Online Forms members can fill out forms online, create packages and send lease agreements to the prospective residents by email, receiving a signature using DocuSign.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports electronic signature workflows to speed up execution and reduce paper handling; ensure recipient email/address workflows are correct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online Forms Tool — multiple output and sharing options
rubrics_metrics.description: E-mail, print, fax, e-sign or save your documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides flexibility in how documents are delivered and stored depending on tenant preferences and recordkeeping requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online Forms Tool — detailed reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed reporting to show member or employee usage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use reporting to audit who accessed or prepared documents, track usage patterns, and support compliance reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online Forms Tool — transaction management
rubrics_metrics.description: Transaction management tools to monitor member/employee contracts, pending contracts and status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enable workflow oversight and reduce missed steps in lease execution and renewals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operational benefits — streamline and reduce costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Streamline your business and reduce operating costs by eliminating the printing, storage and clutter of endless paper files.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopting digital forms can lower overhead, but assess migration effort and training needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Risk reduction through uniform standards of practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Reduce your overall business risk with uniform standards of practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Using standardized CAA forms helps ensure consistent application of legal and procedural requirements across properties and staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access anywhere and mobile compatibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Access your document library anytime from anywhere. Works on all tablet platforms and smartphones.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify compatibility with devices used by staff and ensure secure access controls for remote use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integration via property management software import
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are using property management software that allows importing forms templates (i.e. Yardi) and have 200 or more units on your membership, we can provide our forms electronically to be integrated into your platform.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Integration depends on the PMS import capabilities and membership size; contact CAA office to arrange electronic delivery of templates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ordering preprinted/padded forms and brochures
rubrics_metrics.description: CAA offers preprinted forms that members can order. They are available here.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Members who prefer ready-to-use physical forms or brochures can order preprinted items instead of printing themselves.

rubrics_metrics.name: Membership/access requirement for online forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Sign In to Access Online Forms or Join CAA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Access to online fill-out forms and some features requires CAA account sign-in or membership enrollment.
